      • getMatchStartCommands

        java.util.List<java.lang.String> getMatchStartCommands()
        The commands that will be executed when a match starts. The format for the commands is as follows: "EXECUTOR:COMMAND" Where EXECUTOR is either "CONSOLE" or "PLAYER". The COMMAND is the command to be executed (without the '/').
        Returns:
        List of String commands to be executed on match start

      • getMatchEndCommands

        java.util.List<java.lang.String> getMatchEndCommands()
        The commands that will be executed when a match ends. The format for the commands is as follows: "EXECUTOR:COMMAND" Where EXECUTOR is either "CONSOLE" or "PLAYER". The COMMAND is the command to be executed (without the '/').
        Returns:
        List of String commands to be executed on match end

        Set of XMaterial that are allowed to be dropped

        void applyColored(org.bukkit.entity.Player player,
                  IKitInventory kitInventory,
                  boolean red,

        wool - Whether to apply wool color to applicable items

      • allowedBuild

        boolean allowedBuild()
        Is building allowed in this kit? This is different from the isBuild() rule, which is a toggleable kit rule. This method is used to determine if building is allowed at all, regardless of the kit rule.
        Returns:
        true if building is allowed, false otherwise

      • isFallDamage

        boolean isFallDamage()
        Is fall damage enabled in this kit? This is different from the isNoFall() rule, which is a toggleable kit rule. This method is used to determine if fall damage is enabled at all, regardless of the kit rule.
        Returns:
        true if fall damage is enabled, false otherwise

      • isHungerDisabled

        boolean isHungerDisabled()

        Returns:
        true if hunger is disabled, false otherwise

      • isAntiDrop

        boolean isAntiDrop()
        Is item dropping disabled in this kit? This is different from the isNoDrop() rule, which is a toggleable kit rule. This method is used to determine if item dropping is disabled at all. For example, in battle rush, you cannot drop items.
        Returns:
        true if item dropping is disabled, false otherwise

      • isAntiDamage

        boolean isAntiDamage()

        true if damage is disabled, false otherwise
